newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Spreads spread through market.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Spreads spread through market.

text.p: A relatively benign day in individual equity options was marked by several large spread transactions, both on the call and put side, traders said.
One of the biggest spreads was in the Merrill Lynch and Co Inc January 50 put and the April 60 put, which traded 4,300 contracts and 4,240 contracts, respectively.
The January 50 puts, which were down 1/16 at 3/16 by 1420 CDT (1920 GMT), traded between 1/8 and 3/16. The April 60 puts traded between two and 2-1/8. It was down 3/8 at two.
Open interest on the January 50 put was 7,220. It was 22 on the April 60 put.
Merrill shares were ahead 1-1/2 at 68-1/2 after reaching a new high for the year at 68-3/4.
Traders said an investor closed out an existing position in the Merrill Lynch January 50 puts and rolled out and up to the April 60 puts.
A large bull spread was seen in the CUC International January 40 and 45 calls.
The January 40 call traded 6,440 contracts at prices ranging from 3-1/2 to four. Its open interest was 8,420.
The January 45 call traded nearly 6,100 times on open interest of just more than 30. It traded between 1-1/2 and 1-3/4.
CUC shares were up 7/8 at 40-7/8 after hitting a new high for the year at 41-1/8.
"Somebody did the bull spread," said Harrison Roth, first vice president at Cowen & Co.
Traders said a similar spread crossed in options on Associates First Capital Inc, which was up two 43-3/8, just off its 43-3/4 year high struck earlier in the session.
The December 40 call traded 2,100 times and the December 45 call traded 2,050.
The December 40 call, with open interest of nearly 4,000, was up 1-1/2 at 4-1/8, its session peak. The December 45 call was up 1/2 at one. Its open interest was 63.
In other activity, a couple of calls on shares of Compaq Computer Corp were busy as the stock broke through the 65 strike price.
Compaq gained 1-3/8 to 65-3/4 on nearly three million shares.
The Compaq October 65 call was the most active, having traded about 2,720 contracts, the October 70 call traded 1,680 and the October 60 call traded about 1,450.
"The stock is through 65 and that always causes a little bit of a flurry," Roth said.
The stock had reached an intraday high of 66-1/4.
On the put side, October 65 traded 1,350 contracts and the October 70 traded more than 500.
Some Compaq calls and puts traded all the way out to the April series. --Gregory Crawford, 312-408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
